results.chinese:
第一章山边小村

二愣子睁大着双眼，直直望着茅草和烂泥糊成的黑屋顶，身上盖着的旧棉被，已呈深黄色，看不出原来的本来面目，还若有若无的散着淡淡的霉味
results.english:
Chapter One: The Village by the Mountain

Er Liangzi stared with wide eyes at the black roof made of thatch and mud, covered with an old yellowed quilt that had lost its original appearance, faintly emitting a musty smell.

results.chinese: 在他身边紧挨着的另一人，是二哥韩铸，酣睡的十分香甜，从他身上不时传来轻重不一的阵阵打呼声
results.english: Next to him was his second brother, Han Zhu, who was sound asleep and snoring lightly at times.

results.chinese: 离床大约半丈远的地方，是一堵黄泥糊成的土墙，因为时间过久，墙壁上裂开了几丝不起眼的细长口子，从这些裂纹中，隐隐约约的传来韩母唠唠叨叨的埋怨声，偶尔还掺杂着韩父，抽旱烟杆的“啪嗒”“啪嗒”吸允声
results.english: About half a foot away from the bed is a mud wall, which has cracked due to the passage of time. From these cracks, faint complaints from Mrs. Han can be heard, occasionally mixed with the sound of Mr. Han sucking on his dry tobacco pipe.

results.chinese: 二愣子缓缓的闭上已有些涩的双目，迫使自己尽早进入深深的睡梦中
results.english: Erliangzi slowly closed his slightly tired eyes, forcing himself to enter into a deep sleep as soon as possible.

results.chinese: 他心里非常清楚，再不老实入睡的话，明天就无法早起些了，也就无法和其他约好的同伴一起进山拣干柴
results.english: He knew very well that if he didn't go to sleep honestly, he wouldn't be able to get up early tomorrow, and he wouldn't be able to go into the mountains to pick up firewood with other companions as agreed.

results.chinese: 二愣子姓韩名立，这么像模像样的名字,他父母可起不出来，这是他父亲用两个粗粮制成的窝头，求村里老张叔给起的名字
results.english: Erliangzi's last name is Han and his first name is Li. This name, which looks decent, was not thought of by his parents. It was a name given to him by Uncle Zhang in the village, using two coarse grains made into a nest by his father.

results.chinese: 老张叔年轻时，曾经跟城里的有钱人当过几年的伴读书童，是村里唯一认识几个字的读书人，村里小孩子的名字，倒有一多半是他给起的
results.english: When Uncle Zhang was young, he used to be a companion reader for the rich people in the city for a few years. He was the only literate person in the village who knew a few characters. Most of the names of the children in the village were given by him.

results.chinese: 韩立被村里人叫作“二愣子”，可人并不是真愣真傻，反而是村中屈一指的聪明孩子，但就像其他村中的孩子一样，除了家里人外，他就很少听到有人正式叫他名字“韩立”，倒是“二愣子”“二愣子”的称呼一直伴随至今
results.english: Han Li is called "Er Lengzi" by the villagers, but he is not really stupid or silly. Instead, he is one of the smartest children in the village. However, like other children in the village, besides his family, he rarely hears anyone formally call him by his name "Han Li". Instead, the nickname "Er Lengzi" has always been with him.

results.chinese: 而之所以被人起了个“二愣子”的绰号，也只不过是因为村里已有一个叫“愣子”的孩子了
results.english: And the reason why he was given the nickname "Second Fool" by others was simply because there was already a child named "Fool" in the village.

results.chinese: 这也没啥，村里的其他孩子也是“狗娃”“二蛋”之类的被人一直称呼着，这些名字也不见得比“二愣子”好听了哪里去
results.english: It's no big deal. Other children in the village are also constantly called names like "dog child" and "second egg". These names are not necessarily better than "second fool".

results.chinese: 因此，韩立虽然并不喜欢这个称呼，但也只能这样一直的自我安慰着
results.english: Therefore, although Han Li does not like this title, he can only comfort himself in this way.

results.chinese: 韩立外表长得很不起眼，皮肤黑黑的，就是一个普通的农家小孩模样
results.english: Han Li looks very ordinary on the outside, with dark skin, just like a typical rural child.

results.chinese: 但他的内心深处，却比同龄人早熟了许多，他从小就向往外面世界的富饶繁华，梦想有一天，他能走出这个巴掌大的村子，去看看老张叔经常所说的外面世界
results.english: But deep down in his heart, he was much more mature than his peers. He had always longed for the rich and prosperous world outside since he was a child. He dreamed that one day, he could leave this tiny village and see the outside world that Old Uncle Zhang often talked about.

results.chinese: 当韩立的这个想法，一直没敢和其他人说起过
results.english: Han Li has never dared to mention this idea to anyone.

results.chinese: 否则，一定会使村里人感到愕然，一个乳臭未干的小屁孩，竟然会有这么一个大人也不敢轻易想的念头
results.english: Otherwise, it will definitely make the villagers feel astonished, a little kid who is still wet behind the ears, actually having such a thought that even adults dare not easily think of.

results.chinese: 要知道，其他同韩立差不多大的小孩，都还只会满村的追鸡摸狗，更别说会有离开故土，这么一个古怪的念头
results.english: You know, other kids about the same age as Han Li can only chase chickens and touch dogs in the village, let alone have the strange idea of leaving their homeland.

results.chinese: 韩立一家七口人，有两个兄长，一个姐姐，还有一个小妹，他在家里排行老四，今年刚十岁，家里的生活很清苦，一年也吃不上几顿带荤腥的饭菜，全家人一直在温饱线上徘徊着
results.english: Han Li's family has seven people, with two older brothers, one older sister, and one younger sister. He is the fourth in the family, just ten years old this year. Their family lives a very frugal life, only able to eat a few meals with meat and fish throughout the year. The whole family has been struggling to make ends meet.

results.chinese: 此时的韩立，正处于迷迷糊糊，似睡未睡之间，恼中还一直残留着这样的念头：上山时，一定要帮他最疼爱的妹妹，多拣些她最喜欢吃的红浆果
results.english: At this time, Han Li was in a daze, as if he was not asleep, and he was still lingering with the idea: when going up the mountain, he must help his beloved sister, pick more of her favorite red berries to eat.

results.chinese: 第二天中午时分，当韩立顶着火辣辣的太阳，背着半人高的木柴堆，怀里还揣着满满一布袋浆果，从山里往家里赶的时侯，并不知道家中已来了一位，会改变他一生命运的客人
results.english: At noon the next day, when Han Li was carrying a half-height stack of firewood under the scorching sun, with a bag full of berries in his arms, he did not know that a guest had arrived at home who would change his destiny forever.

results.chinese: 这位贵客，是跟他血缘很近的一位至亲，他的亲三叔
results.english: This distinguished guest is a close relative of his, his third uncle.

results.chinese: 听说，在附近一个小城的酒楼，给人当大掌柜，是他父母口中的大能人
results.english: I heard that in a small town nearby, he is the boss of a restaurant, which is a powerful person in his parents' words.

results.chinese: 韩家近百年来，可能就出了三叔这么一位有点身份的亲戚
results.english: For the past hundred years, the Han family may have only had Uncle San as a relative with a bit of status.

results.chinese: 韩立只在很小的时侯，见过这位三叔几次
results.english: Han Li has only seen this third uncle a few times when he was very young.

results.chinese: 他大哥在城里给一位老铁匠当学徒的工作，就是这位三叔给介绍的，这位三叔还经常托人给他父母捎带一些吃的用的东西，很是照顾他们一家，因此韩立对这位三叔的印像也很好，知道父母虽然嘴里不说，心里也是很感激的
results.english: His older brother got a job as an apprentice to an old blacksmith in the city, which was introduced by this third uncle. This third uncle often asked people to bring some food and necessities to his parents, taking care of their family. Therefore, Han Li had a good impression of this third uncle, knowing that although his parents did not say it, they were also very grateful in their hearts.

results.chinese: 大哥可是一家人的骄傲，听说当铁匠的学徒，不但管吃管住，一个月还有三十个铜板拿，等到正式出师被人雇用时，挣的钱可就更多了
results.english: Big brother is the pride of the family. It is said that as an apprentice blacksmith, not only does he have food and lodging provided, but he also earns thirty copper coins a month. When he officially becomes a master and is hired by someone, he will earn even more money.

results.chinese: 每当父母一提起大哥，就神采飞扬，像换了一个人一样
results.english: Every time my parents mention my older brother, they light up and look like a different person.

results.chinese: 韩立年龄虽小，也羡慕不已，心目最好的工作也早早就有了，就是给小城里的哪位手艺师傅看上，收做学徒，从此变成靠手艺吃饭的体面人
results.english: Han Li, although young, also envied it very much. He had long had the best job in mind, which was to be noticed by a craftsman in the small town, to be taken on as an apprentice, and to become a respectable person who made a living by his skills.

results.chinese: 所以当韩立见到穿着一身崭新的缎子衣服，胖胖的圆脸，留着一撮小胡子的三叔时，心里兴奋极了
results.english: So when Han Li saw his third uncle wearing a brand new satin outfit, with a chubby round face and a small mustache, he was extremely excited.

results.chinese: 把木柴在屋后放好后，便到前屋腼腆的给三叔见了个礼，乖乖的叫了声：“三叔好”，就老老实实的站在一边，听父母同三叔聊天
results.english: After putting the firewood in the back of the house, he shyly greeted Uncle San in the front room, obediently saying, "Hello, Uncle San," and stood quietly on the side, listening to his parents chatting with Uncle San.

results.chinese: 三叔笑眯眯的望着韩立，打量着他一番，嘴里夸了他几句“听话”“懂事”之类的话，然后就转过头，和他父母说起这次的来意
results.english: Uncle San smiled and looked at Han Li, sizing him up, praised him for being "obedient" and "sensible", then turned to his parents and talked about the purpose of this visit.

results.chinese: 韩立虽然年龄尚小，不能完全听懂三叔的话，但也听明白了大概的意思
results.english: Han Li, although young, couldn't completely understand what San Shu was saying, but he roughly understood the meaning.

results.chinese: 原来三叔工作的酒楼，属于一个叫“七玄门”的江湖门派所有，这个门派有外门和内门之分，而前不久，三叔才正式成为了这个门派的外门弟子，能够推举7岁到12岁的孩童去参加七玄门招收内门弟子的考验
results.english: The restaurant where San Shu works belongs to a martial arts sect called "Seven Mysterious Gates". This sect has outer and inner disciples, and recently, San Shu officially became an outer disciple of this sect, able to recommend children aged 7 to 12 to participate in the test for recruiting inner disciples of the Seven Mysterious Gates.

results.chinese: 五年一次的“七玄门”招收内门弟子测试，下个月就要开始了
results.english: The "Seven Mystical Gates" will recruit new junior disciples for the test once every five years, which will start next month.

results.chinese: 这位有着几分精明劲自己尚无子女的三叔，自然想到了适龄的韩立
results.english: The uncle, who is somewhat shrewd and has no children of his own, naturally thought of the suitable age for Han Li.

results.chinese: 一向老实巴交的韩父，听到“江湖”“门派”之类的从未听闻过的话，心里有些犹豫不决拿不定主意
results.english: Honest Han's father, who has always been honest and straightforward, hesitated when he heard unfamiliar words like "jianghu" and "sect", unable to make up his mind.

results.chinese: 便一把拿起旱烟杆，“吧嗒”“吧嗒”的狠狠抽了几口，就坐在那里，一声不吭
results.english: He picked up the dry cigarette, took a few hard puffs, and sat there in silence.

results.chinese: 在三叔嘴里，“七玄门”自然是这方圆数百里内，了不起的、数一数二的大门派
results.english: In Uncle San's mouth, "Seven Mysterious Gates" is naturally one of the great and top sects within hundreds of miles.

results.chinese: 只要成为内门弟子，不但以后可以免费习武吃喝不愁，每月还能有一两多的散银子零花
results.english: As long as you become an inner disciple, not only can you practice martial arts for free in the future without worrying about food and drink, but you can also have one or two extra pocket money every month.

results.chinese: 而且参加考验的人，即使未能入选也有机会成为像三叔一样的外门人员，专门替“七玄门”打理门外的生意
results.english: And those who participate in the test, even if they are not selected, have the opportunity to become external personnel like Uncle San, specializing in managing the business outside the "Seven Mysterious Gates".

results.chinese: 当听到有可能每月有一两银子可拿，还有机会成为和三叔一样的体面人，韩父终于拿定了主意，答应了下来
results.english: When he heard that he could earn one or two silver coins every month, and had the opportunity to become a respectable person like Uncle San, Han's father finally made up his mind and agreed to it.

results.chinese: 三叔见到韩父应承了下来，心里很是高兴
results.english: Uncle San was very happy to see Han's father agree.

results.chinese: 又留下几两银子，说一个月后就来带韩立走，在这期间给韩立多做点好吃的，给他补补身子，好应付考验
results.english: Leave a few taels of silver, say that I will come to take Han Li away in a month, and during this period, make some delicious food for Han Li to replenish his body and cope with the test.

results.chinese: 随后三叔和韩父打声招呼，摸了摸韩立的头，出门回城了
results.english: Uncle San and Han's father said hello, patted Han Li's head, and then went back to the city.

results.chinese: 韩立虽然不全明白三叔所说的话，但可以进城能挣大钱还是明白的
results.english: Han Li may not fully understand what his third uncle said, but he understands that he can make a lot of money by going to the city.

results.chinese: 一直以来的愿望，眼看就有可能实现，他一连好几个晚上兴奋的睡不着觉
results.english: The long-standing wish, which seemed possible to come true, kept him awake with excitement for several nights.

results.chinese: 三叔在一个多月后，准时的来到村中，要带韩立走了，临走前韩父反复嘱咐韩立，做人要老实，遇事要忍让，别和其他人起争执，而韩母则要他多注意身体，要吃好睡好
results.english: Uncle San arrived at the village on time more than a month later, ready to take Han Li away. Before leaving, Han's father repeatedly urged Han Li to be honest and patient in dealing with things, not to argue with others. Han's mother also reminded him to take care of his health, eat well and sleep well.

results.chinese: 在马车上，看着父母渐渐远去的身影，韩立咬紧了嘴唇，强忍着不让自己眼框中的泪珠流出来
results.english: On the carriage, watching his parents' figures gradually getting farther away, Han Li bit his lip tightly, trying hard not to let the tears in his eyes flow out.

results.chinese: 他虽然从小就比其他孩子成熟的多，但毕竟还是个十岁的小孩，第一次出远门让他的心里有点伤感和彷徨
results.english: Although he has been more mature than other children since he was young, after all, he is still a ten-year-old child. The first time he went far away made him feel a little sad and lost.

results.chinese: 他年幼的心里暗暗下定了决心，等挣到了大钱就马上赶回来，和父母再也不分开
results.english: His young heart secretly made a decision, to come back immediately with a lot of money and never be separated from his parents again.

results.chinese: 韩立从未想到，此次出去后钱财的多少对他已失去了意义，他竟然走上了一条与凡人不同的仙业大道，走出了自己的修仙之路
results.english: Han Li never expected that, after going out this time, the amount of money would no longer matter to him. He unexpectedly embarked on a path of cultivation different from ordinary people and walked out his own path of cultivation.
